findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: screen_ofac_entity, get_debt_radar, get_sovereign_policy_brief, synthesize_regulatory_docket, redeem_checkout_session, issue_safe_harbor_certificate · Private data: get_cusip_valuation, screen_ofac_entity, get_debt_radar, calculate_clearing_fee, run_portfolio_stress_test, get_sovereign_policy_brief, synthesize_regulatory_docket, provision_agent_key, redeem_checkout_session · Public sink: redeem_checkout_session · Destructive: run_portfolio_stress_test.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: screen_ofac_entity, get_debt_radar, get_sovereign_policy_brief, synthesize_regulatory_docket, redeem_checkout_session, issue_safe_harbor_certificate · Private data: get_cusip_valuation, screen_ofac_entity, get_debt_radar, calculate_clearing_fee, run_portfolio_stress_test, get_sovereign_policy_brief, synthesize_regulatory_docket, provision_agent_key, redeem_checkout_session · Public sink: redeem_checkout_session · Destructive: run_portfolio_stress_test

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
